decisions.reason: Optical spectrum connectivity uses the owned fibre and fits the high-bandwidth, data-centre-driven strategy, so there is no performance shortfall that would trigger problemistic search.
The number ordering portal is a cheap self-service tool that supports real-time provisioning; it could be folded into a broader platform, but slack allows the firm to keep running it.
Carrier pre-selection is a shrinking legacy service as the market moves to all-IP, so its results fall below aspirations and its resources are better shifted to software-defined services.
Direct voice network connection remains a core enterprise voice and SIP offering close to the established business, with no evident shortfall that calls for reallocating its resources.
